reuse.why: Extends the existing shared isWeekendOrHoliday predicate rather than adding a new one, but does not route the two inline holiday checks in server/schedules/app.ts through it.

duplication.why: The diff itself adds no duplicated logic; the pre-existing inline copies of the holiday test in app.ts remain and now diverge from the shared rule.

placement.why: The month-day matching lives in the shared schedules predicate where the holiday rule already sits.

scope.why: Small, focused change to one predicate plus tests.

maintainability.why: Simple and readable, but the holiday rule is still applied in three places and only one learned the MM-DD form, so getUpcomingDates/getDatesInRange daily filtering silently ignores recurring holidays.

bypasses_abstraction.where: The diff adds no new bypass; the pre-existing inline checks in server/schedules/app.ts getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange already bypass isWeekendOrHoliday and were left as is.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic introduced by the diff.
